title: Space Inside the Case
tagline: The night before the festival, eight machines lie dead and the museum doors open at nine.
blurb: The night before the festival, eight machines lie dead and the museum doors open at nine. Fly your little probe gently through their insides, lift out each part and land it in its socket before the clock runs out. Wake all eight and the whole museum lights up at dawn.

review.verdict: A gentle charmer that really gets inside your circuits. Bring a steady hand and a full kettle.

quote.text: I like a game that tells you what's what

credits.name: Norm Crabtree, Prue Fairley and Baz Pocket for INK & PAPER
